GLKN LandTrendr_disturbance_polygons -- HUC_12 field inventory
Generated 2026-09-22. Source: GLKN/LandTrendr GDB, layer LandTrendr_disturbance_polygons.
Total rows: 177153. Rows with a populated HUC_12: 63448. Rows with no HUC_12 (null): 113704. Rows with empty-string HUC_12: 1.
Distinct non-blank HUC_12 values: 247 (230 standard 12-digit USGS-format + 17 non-standard).

IMPORTANT (added after re-examination, see docs/data_inventory.md HUC_12 section for full detail):
GLKN documentation for at least Sleeping Bear Dunes (slbe) states its analysis used HUC10 units,
despite this field being named HUC_12. Checked directly: for every park using the numeric scheme
(including slbe), the codes show multiple distinct 12-digit values per shared 10-digit prefix with
varied non-"00" suffixes -- the structural signature of genuine HUC12 codes, NOT a HUC10 code
zero-padded to 12 digits. The 230 codes below are safe to look up as literal HUC12 codes in the
national WBD, but for slbe specifically, confirm with Al whether the report's HUC10-level numbers
correspond to these 25 HUC12s or to their 7 distinct HUC10 parents before picking a boundary set --
do not assume either without asking.

Three values are placeholder-like, not real subwatershed geography (see docs/data_inventory.md):
isro 040203000000 (19 rows, isro's only "standard" code), slbe 040602000000 (9 rows, 0.2% of
slbe's populated codes), voya 090300012400 (329 rows, less clear-cut -- only the final pair is 00).
